body:
Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-20 10:33Z, from 8 occurrences today across 5 sessions: Sol-1cee, Sol-d50d, CSharpProof, Sol-edfd and Coder, on both Codex and Claude workers). When a send to a worker returns notificationDisposition "durableButNotWoken", check that session right away with GET /api/state. If it is idle with queuePaused=true, POST /api/sessions/{id}/queue/resume and re-check; it should go active. Then record the occurrence on w-80e0cb2002da. Do not resend: the message is already durable, and the resume delivers it. Without this, the worker sits idle on a GO until the next watchdog tick. This holds until w-80e0's fix is live on the running host.

Refinement (Fable2, 2026-10-20 14:00Z). Before resuming, read the head's last engramControl card with GET /api/sessions/{id} and look at its continuationReason. (a) "Automatic retry scheduled … next at T" (persist-writer Deadline under gate load, w-1fcaa9b93d12): Resume returns 200 but is a no-op, because the retry scheduler owns the head. Wait past T; it recovers by itself (Advisor and Sol-c593 at 13:58Z). (b) "Automatic continuation withheld: retained authorization requires reconciliation" (for example "named-root acknowledgement belongs to a superseded authority image"): w-b21c5132848c. Resume is silently a no-op. Only a UI retry or cancel of the head by the lane owner or Greg clears it, and agents do not touch it. (c) A plain Stop-paused queue with no retained head: resume as above (w-80e0).

Update to (b), 14:40Z: the variant CAN be cleared without Greg. The lane's OWNER (not the coordinator, for another project's lane) POSTs /api/sessions/{id}/queued-prompts/{head_prompt_id}/cancel, then /queue/resume, and the next head starts. This was verified on 11330 (w-b21c note). The cancelled wake's mailbox bodies stay unread, so nothing is lost. For a TermAl lane, the coordinator may do it after confirming that the head is a pure wake (mailbox notification text) that was never granted.
